# T-1: Reject invalid report inputs

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make report input loading fail closed so required unreadable or invalid artifacts cannot become successful empty data.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 invalid issue-log and other required input failures propagate as report failure.
- No report success path substitutes a failed required read with empty entries.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing IssueLogStore and strict artifact-validation boundaries. Keep missing optional report artifacts distinct from malformed required artifacts.

## Test Strategy
Add unit and spec-local tests for corrupt JSON, invalid issue-log shape, and unreadable required source input.
